meaning: Finalized review-candidate outcomes recorded separately from mutable queue status. Certification remains authoritative only through the ecosystem review ledger and exact certification receipt.

decisions.summary: The healthy DaAsh release was re-reviewed and promoted into the canonical ecosystem ledger and certification receipt.
A newer healthy Travel candidate replaced this release before the final canonical review was completed.
Travel Layer 240 was accepted into the canonical ecosystem ledger and certification receipt after healthy deployment and security-diff review evidence.
Build 22 replaced the pending Build 21 Wellness candidate before human review was finalized; no review findings or authorization carry forward.
